doclang.heading: 7.3.4.2 FREE SHARES GRANTED TO MANAGERS
doclang.text: A total of 840,755 free shares had been granted to managers as of August 31, 2013 (representing approximately 0.53% of the capital and a dilutive impact of no more than 0.53% based on the share capital at that

date). The cost of these free shares was 47,199,986 euro based on fair value at the grant date, taking into account the related terms and conditions. This fi rst allocation concerned 1,123 benefi ciaries.
